title: Prosecution to present 100 witnesses in Duterte crimes against humanity trial

blocks.text: The International Criminal Court Office of the Prosecutor is expected to present around 100 witnesses in the crimes against humanity trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte, the tribunal’s spokesperson said on Tuesday, about a week before proceedings in the Hague are slated to begin.
